title: Sport Ballooning Xperience
specs: Flights at sunrise and prior to sunset for favorable winds
Flight altitude between 500 ft and 3,500 ft, usually about 2,000 ft
Flight distance typically 6 to 12 miles depending on wind
Ability to climb into basket, stand for an hour, and help with light physical tasks if desired
Notify if passenger weight is above 200 lbs for load balancing
Check with physician if recently had broken bones, surgery, pregnant, or medical issues
Basket holds 3 to 4 passengers plus pilot depending on weight and size
If party exceeds 4, another balloonist may assist
includes: Introduction to many aspects of ballooning during involvement
Traditional toast at the conclusion of the experience
gap: Exact minimum and maximum age not stated
blurb: Guests participate in assembling, inflating, flying, and packing up the hot air balloon. Flights last about an hour with a total experience time of approximately 3 hours. Flights include a traditional toast at the conclusion.
extraNote: Reservations paid in full by cash, check, credit card (+3.7% convenience charge), or gift certificate · Cancel at least 24 hours in advance to avoid fees · Late cancellations or no-shows may forfeit fees or incur rescheduling charges · Flights cancelled by operator for high winds, rain, thunderstorms, snow, extreme heat/cold, FAA restrictions · Final decision to fly made by pilot at launch site for safety · All passengers must sign a waiver before flight · No smoking near balloon or in basket; no alcohol on board; intoxicated passengers not allowed · Gilbertsville, PA (New Hanover Township) launch site
